edition_angle: Investigating circadian disruption on hippocampal molecular clocks and neuroplasticity pathways.

assignments.angle: Adolescent exposure to artificial blue light at night directly alters subordinate circadian clocks in the dentate gyrus, impairing hippocampal plasticity signaling pathways in a sex-dependent manner.
assignments.reason: Provides a specific biophysical and cellular mechanism of circadian disruption impacting hippocampal clock machinery and plasticity signaling, fitting the Luminous Mind/Inner Garden domain while avoiding repetitive dementia topics.
